programme.title: SEMBANG SELEBRITI

programme.title: Misteri Wan Peah EP5
programme.desc: Farhan bercadang untuk pulang dan bekerja di kampung, bapanya tidak bersetuju. Pada satu malam, Aishah mengigau berjalan masuk ke dalam rumah Wan Peah. Siti meminta bantuan 3 sahabat karibnya membawa Aishah balik ke rumah. Li berkejar ke rumah Tok Hashim meminta pertolongan. Sesampai Tok Hashim ke rumah Wan Peah, Siti berjaya mengeluarkan anaknya, Tok Hashim terus mencari Wan Peah. Tiba-tiba muncul Wan Peah di hadapannya. Tok Hashim melarikan diri sambil meracau-racau.(n)

programme.title: Misteri Wan Peah EP6
programme.desc: Zaiton menyimpan perasaan kepada Farhan dan berniat untuk berkahwin dengan pemuda ini. Perkenalan Farhan dengan Siti telah membuat Farhan semakin suka dengan kerjayanya. Zaiton cemburu melihat perhubungan tersebut, dia meminta Mak Timah berhati-hati dengan Siti yang dikatakan mempunyai ilmu hitam. programme.title: Misteri Wan Peah EP7

Kemudian Li dan adik-beradik Siti ke rumah Wan Peah kerana ternampak bayangan seseorang di situ. Aishah menegur Wan Peah semasa menaiki rumah tersebut kerana dia percaya Wan Peah bukan hantu.(n)

programme.title: Misteri Wan Peah EP8
programme.desc: Li balik ke rumah dengan ketakutan dan menceritakan dia telah ternampak dengan Wan Peah. Siti dan adik-adiknya terpaksa lari dan bermalam di surau. Keesokan hari, Siti mengadu dan minta bantuan untuk tinggal di rumah Tok Hashim. Tok Hashim setuju tapi Mak Timah tidak selesa dengan kehadiran mereka. Tok Hashim kemudian membenarkan Siti terus tinggal di rumahnya. Li dan Ghani terjumpa dengan Ramli (anak Wan Peah) tetapi dia melarikan diri kerana tidak mahu berjumpa dengan mereka.(n)

programme.title: Obsesi Dia EP8
programme.desc: Zack terkesima melihat wajah Alia yang saling tak tumpah mirip Affiyah. Kai pembantu Zack dapat maklumat bahawa Alia pernah hilang ingatan akibat kemalangan yang meragut nayawa ibu dan bapa serta saudara kembarnya. Alia sekarang tinggal bersama abangnya,Ritz. Tanpa berlengah Zack menghubungi Ritz. Ritz yang cemas menerima panggi an Zacky enggan melayannya. Ali terserempak dengan kereta Zacky lalu mengekorinya. Tiba disatu lorong Alia menyaksikan pertarungan antara Zacky dengan sekumpulan lelaki yang bersenjatakan kayu dan pistol. Zack cedera namunberjaya dibawa ke kelinik dan dirawat oleh Dr Flora dan Dr Zahir.(n)

programme.title: Interchange
programme.desc: Dihantui oleh penglihatan yang suram, jurugambar forensik Adam berundur dari dunia, tinggal di rumah dan mengambil gambar jirannya sehingga dia diseret ke dalam penyiasatan lain oleh kawan baiknya, Detektif Man, yang meminta bantuannya untuk menyelesaikan siri pembunuhan ritual yang mengerikan. Pada masa yang sama, hobi Adam yang kelihatan tidak berbahaya tidak lama kemudian menjadi lebih gelap apabila dia mengintip Iva, seorang wanita muda dari Borneo. Terpesona olehnya, dia tidak lama lagi terjerat dalam rangkaian misteri dan pembunuhannya. Ketika Adam diseret lebih jauh ke dalam dunia puak Iva dan Man menyelidiki penyiasatannya dengan lebih mendalam, mereka menemui mistik bawah tanah bomoh dan makhluk ghaib di bandar itu.(n)

programme.desc: Kesilapannya mungkin menyebabkan dia dipenjara, tetapi bagi Firman, ia juga menjadi pemangkin permulaan baru dalam hidup. Trisya seorang gadis yang mendambakan untuk dicintai, tetapi apabila bertemu dengannya barulah dia sedar bahawa cinta sejati bukanlah hamparan bunga mawar. programme.title: Perempuan Ilmu Hitam EP1
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Lisa dari sebuah NGO masuk ke kampung untuk membantu Bayu yang menjadi mangsa rogol. Insiden tersebut mengingatkan Lisa kejadian yang sama pernah berlaku kepadanya 7 tahun lalu di rogol oleh sekumpulan lelaki bertopeng. Bayu kemudiannya meninggal dunia. Mbah Ngai dibantu oleh Afifa membantu Siti anak Pak Samad yang sedang kemurungan. Afifa mengambil kesempatan, kononnya Siti terkena ilmu hitam. Pak Samad membayar sejumlah wang upahan kepada Afifa bagi membalas dendam perbuatan bomoh tersebut. Mbah Ngai menjaga Sarah anak kepada Afifa yang mengalami tekanan. programme.desc: Datin Sharifah ialah seorang balu yang mempunyai dua orang anak remaja, Shah dan Ina. programme.title: Bisikan Remaja
programme.desc: Ameera yang baru berpindah dari Sabah ke Kuala Lumpur bersekolah di kolej swasta, dan dipilih sebagai ketua kelas. Rakan-rakan Daniel bagaimanapun merasakan bahawa Daniel, sebagai ahli sukan kolej, lebih layak untuk jawatan itu. Ketidakpuasan hati ini memecahkan kelas kepada dua puak. Ameera semakin popular kerana kecantikan, kecerdasan dan personalitinya. Daniel membuat taruhan dengan rakan-rakannya, bahawa dia akan dapat memenangi hati Ameera dalam masa dua minggu. Apabila Ameera mengetahui tentang pertaruhan itu, dia dan Daniel menjadi musuh, walaupun telah membina perasaan bersama antara satu sama lain.(n)

programme.title: Suara Kekasih
programme.desc: Percintaan yang ditentang keluarga kerana perbezaan darjat membuatkan Ayu dan Taufiq terpaksa membawa haluan berbeza. Ayu, penyanyi di kelab malam jatuh cinta dengan Taufiq, pengurus syarikat insuran yang berasal dari keluarga kaya. Ditentang oleh ibu Taufiq, mereka merasakan restu keluarga amat penting dan terpaksa membuat keputusan penting untuk masa depan mereka.(n)

programme.title: Si Jantung Hati
programme.desc: Dua adik beradik, Do dan Re, keluar menggembara untuk mencari harta pusaka kepunyaan ayah mereka yang telah lama disembunyikan. Sebelum itu, mereka perlu mencari sahabat lama ayah mereka yang mempunyai petunjuk lokasi harta itu. Tetapi sesuatu terjadi apabila musuh lama muncul kembali untuk mengambil harta pusaka itu kerana yakin bahawa itu miliknya yang telah dicuri ayah mereka bertahun-tahun dahulu.(n)

programme.title: Manis Manis Sayang
programme.desc: Terkesan dengan tingkah laku Bahadom terhadapnya di khalayak ramai, Jalil membuat keputusan untuk berhenti bekerja. Namun Bahadom mempunyai rancangan lain apabila Datuk menyuruhnya untuk mencari seorang pegawai untuk dihantar ke luar negara. Kerana bencikan Jalil dan juga ingin memisahkannya dari Rosnah, Bahadom mahu menghantar Jalil ke luar negara.(n)

programme.title: Si Luncai
programme.desc: Cinta ditolak kerana pangkat dan darjat, Si Luncai, sang pengembala kambing pergi dengan harapan yang hancur. Dirinya yang lurus dipermainkan oleh Ketua Kampung - namun kejadian tersebut telah membawanya ke seorang nenek kebayan yang telah mengubah hidupnya. Si Luncai menyamar menjadi tukang tabib dan mempermainkan semula Ketua Kampung itu. Berjayakah rancangan Si Luncai untuk mendapatkan cintanya?(n)

Dirinya yang lurus dipermainkan oleh Ketua Kampung - namun kejadian tersebut telah membawanya ke seorang nenek kebayan yang telah mengubah hidupnya. Si Luncai menyamar menjadi tukang tabib dan mempermainkan semula Ketua Kampung itu. Berjayakah rancangan Si Luncai untuk mendapatkan cintanya?(n)

programme.title: Sindrom Mana Anakku
programme.desc: Dr. Kamal dan Dr. Lisa bekerja di hospital yang sama. Dr. Kamal keluar mendapat panggilan kecemasan di sebuah rumah. Dibawa pesakit tersebut ke hospital kerana kemungkinan komplikasi kelahiran namun mula tertanya-tanya di manakah anaknya. Anak pesakit tersebut perlu dicari sebelum apa-apa berlaku kepadanya.(n)

programme.title: Suci Dalam Debu
programme.desc: Roy, seorang anak kaya yang ingin berkawan dengan pemuzik bertemu Rina di sebuah kelab malam. Namun, Rina telah ditunangkan dengan Tengku Johan oleh bapanya, Tengku Aziz. Tengku Johan ingin mempercepatkan tarikh perkahwinan mereka kerana ingin memiliki Rina. Roy telah dicabar dan diletakkan taruhan oleh Tengku Johan jika benar dia boleh mendapatkan Rina.(n)

programme.title: Antara Dua Hati
programme.desc: Datin Sharifah ialah seorang balu yang mempunyai dua orang anak remaja, Shah dan Ina. Shah mempunyai seorang teman wanita berbangsa Cina yang bernama Linda dan Ina pula bercinta dengan Johari. Dalam satu kemalangan, Datin Sharifah telah berkenalan dengan Jefri, seorang penyanyi kelab malam. Hubungan mereka kemudiannya menjadi semakin intim. Dalam masa yang sama, Ina pula jatuh cinta dengan Jefri.(n)

programme.title: Suara Kekasih
programme.desc: Percintaan yang ditentang keluarga kerana perbezaan darjat membuatkan Ayu dan Taufiq terpaksa membawa haluan berbeza. Ayu, penyanyi di kelab malam jatuh cinta dengan Taufiq, pengurus syarikat insuran yang berasal dari keluarga kaya. Ditentang oleh ibu Taufiq, mereka merasakan restu keluarga amat penting dan terpaksa membuat keputusan penting untuk masa depan mereka.(n)

programme.title: Manis Manis Sayang
programme.desc: Terkesan dengan tingkah laku Bahadom terhadapnya di khalayak ramai, Jalil membuat keputusan untuk berhenti bekerja. Namun Bahadom mempunyai rancangan lain apabila Datuk menyuruhnya untuk mencari seorang pegawai untuk dihantar ke luar negara. Kerana bencikan Jalil dan juga ingin memisahkannya dari Rosnah, Bahadom mahu menghantar Jalil ke luar negara.(n)

programme.title: Bisikan Remaja
programme.desc: Ameera yang baru berpindah dari Sabah ke Kuala Lumpur bersekolah di kolej swasta, dan dipilih sebagai ketua kelas. Rakan-rakan Daniel bagaimanapun merasakan bahawa Daniel, sebagai ahli sukan kolej, lebih layak untuk jawatan itu. Ketidakpuasan hati ini memecahkan kelas kepada dua puak. Ameera semakin popular kerana kecantikan, kecerdasan dan personalitinya. Daniel membuat taruhan dengan rakan-rakannya, bahawa dia akan dapat memenangi hati Ameera dalam masa dua minggu. Apabila Ameera mengetahui tentang pertaruhan itu, dia dan Daniel menjadi musuh, walaupun telah membina perasaan bersama antara satu sama lain.(n)

programme.title: Si Jantung Hati
programme.desc: Dua adik beradik, Do dan Re, keluar menggembara untuk mencari harta pusaka kepunyaan ayah mereka yang telah lama disembunyikan. Sebelum itu, mereka perlu mencari sahabat lama ayah mereka yang mempunyai petunjuk lokasi harta itu. Tetapi sesuatu terjadi apabila musuh lama muncul kembali untuk mengambil harta pusaka itu kerana yakin bahawa itu miliknya yang telah dicuri ayah mereka bertahun-tahun dahulu.(n)

programme.title: Bayangan Cinta
programme.desc: Pertemuan dua bekas kekasih, Auzy dan Akhbar selepas 18 tahun membangkitkan perasaan lama. Walau perasaan cinta masih kuat, hubungan mereka tidak dapat diteruskan kerana Akhbar sudah pun berkahwin. Suratan takdir mengatakan sebaliknya apabila Auzy kini mengajar anak kepada Akhbar, Andy.(n)

programme.title: The Pursuit Of Happyness
programme.desc: Chris Gardner, seorang ayah tunggal, menghadapi kesusahan kewangan selepas pelaburan perniagaannya gagal. Dia berjuang untuk mencari pekerjaan sambil menjaga anaknya, Christopher. programme.desc: Mengisahkan Luqman pernah mengenali seorang gadis bernama Diana ketika Diana melanggar keretanya dahulu. Tanpa mengetahui, Adawiyah dan Diana adalah orang yang sama. Diana pernah terlibat dengan kemalangan dan sejak itu hidupnya berubah sepenuhnya.(n)

programme.title: Melawan Takdir
programme.desc: Filem ni kisahkan perjalanan hidup Quraisy Mathar sendiri (pengarah filem ni). Ia mengangkat pengalaman hidupnya yang penuh cabaran sejak kecil — kehilangan orang tersayang, jatuh bangun dalam hidup, sampai berjaya jadi seorang sineas. programme.desc: Kisah dua beradik yatim piatu, Anton dan Angel, yang terpisah selepas kemalangan ketika hidup dalam sindiket pengemis jalanan. Bertahun kemudian, Angel yang telah berjaya sebagai peguam kembali ke Jakarta untuk mencari semula abangnya yang hilang.(n)

programme.title: Dilan 1990
programme.desc: Cerita cinta remaja antara Dilan, seorang pelajar yang unik dan romantik, dengan Milea, pelajar baru yang berpindah ke Bandung pada tahun 1990. Cara Dilan yang berbeza dalam mendekati Milea membuatkan hubungan mereka berkembang, tetapi mereka juga perlu menghadapi cabaran persahabatan, sekolah dan kehidupan remaja.(n)

programme.title: Reaksiar
programme.desc: Program yang memaparkan perkongsian pengalaman dan reaksi artis-artis jemputan setelah melihat kembali klip-klip lakonan mereka.(n)

programme.title: Dilan 1991
programme.desc: Sambungan kisah cinta Dilan dan Milea selepas mereka menjadi pasangan. Hubungan mereka mula diuji apabila Dilan semakin terlibat dengan geng motor dan pergaduhan di sekolah, menyebabkan Milea risau dan hubungan mereka menjadi tegang. Milea terpaksa membuat keputusan yang sukar demi masa depan mereka.(n)

programme.title: Kasih Seorang Ayah
programme.desc: Husin yang baru memulakan pekerjaan baharu dikejutkan oleh panggilan isterinya, Aminah—ayahnya, Pak Yusof, tidak pulang sejak keluar pagi tadi. Setelah mencari ke merata tempat, Husin akhirnya menemui Pak Yusof di sebuah perhentian bas dalam keadaan keliru dan ketakutan. Pak Yusof tidak ingat jalan pulang, malah tidak tahu di mana dia berada. Hairan dengan perubahan sikap ayahnya, Husin membawa beliau ke klinik. Di situlah mereka menerima berita yang mengejutkan: Pak Yusof menghidap Alzheimer. Dari saat itu, bermulalah perjalanan penuh cabaran buat Husin dan keluarganya dalam menjaga insan yang mereka sayangi.(n)

programme.title: Jika Fattah
programme.desc: Kehadiran Fattah yang merupakan seorang anak yatim di dalam keluarga Zaidi telah mengubah kehidupan mereka sekeluarga melalui sikap terpuji yang ada di dalam diri Fattah yang menyedarkan Zaidi dan isterinya Intan.(n)

programme.title: Saleha
programme.desc: Saleha mengisahkan seorang gadis baik hati yang ditinggalkan oleh ayahnya dan dibesarkan oleh nenek. Selepas diculik dan kehilangan neneknya, dia dipersalahkan dan dihalau oleh keluarganya. Dengan semangat dan keimanan yang teguh, Saleha memulakan hidup baru di Jakarta sambil menyembunyikan penyakit serius.(n)

programme.title: Ketika Jamu Tak Berhenti Di Sini
programme.desc: Molly (Djihan Ranti) berusaha mencari rezeki dengan menjual jamu segera dalam botol bersama adiknya di kampus demi menampung perbelanjaan harian. Perniagaan mereka semakin mendapat sambutan apabila rakan-rakan kampus turut membantu memasarkan produk tersebut. Namun, Molly masih bergelut dengan masalah kewangan sehingga sewa biliknya sering tertunggak. Suatu kejadian telah menemukan Molly dengan Vian (Julian Jacob), dan hubungan mereka semakin rapat, sekali gus mencetuskan rasa cemburu dalam diri teman wanita Vian.(n)

programme.title: Wanita Istimewa
programme.desc: Mirsa (Alisia Rininta) dan Radit (Reuben Elishama) hidup sederhana di Padang sehingga satu kesilapan besar berlaku apabila Radit tanpa sedar membawa beg berisi dadah. Untuk melindungi suaminya, Mirsa menyerah diri dan dipenjara selama tujuh tahun, manakala bayi yang dilahirkannya terpaksa diserahkan kepada ibu mertuanya untuk dijaga. Selepas dibebaskan, Mirsa mencari keluarganya tetapi mendapati Radit sudah berpindah ke Jakarta. Jejak itu membawa Mirsa ke sebuah acara pelancaran perumahan di mana dia bertemu semula dengan Radit yang kini bersama isterinya Karina (Naomi Zaskia) dan berkenalan dengan Reza (Randy Pangalila), sementara tekanan daripada Pramana (Adipura) terhadap perkahwinan mereka mula terbongkar.(n)

programme.title: Cinta Setelah Cinta
programme.desc: Starla menyangka dia telah menghadapi segalanya, tetapi penipuan Niko jauh lebih mendalam daripada yang disangkanya. Ketika dia terus berusaha mempertahankan perkahwinannya, ancaman baharu muncul. Ayu, yang masih taksub dengan Niko, semakin mengikatnya dalam perangkap dengan menggunakan anak mereka yang belum lahir sebagai umpan. Pada masa yang sama, naluri Starla merasakan ada sesuatu yang tidak kena, dan dia mula diburu oleh bayang-bayang serta rahsia gelap. Dengan keluarganya di ambang bahaya dan emosinya semakin tertekan, adakah Starla mampu melindungi orang-orang tersayang? Atau adakah pengkhianatan Niko akan mendorongnya melangkaui batas yang tidak boleh kembali?(n)

programme.title: Makan Terooos
programme.desc: Jelajahi kekayaan masakan yang menampilkan rasa autentik. Sertai kami dalam pengembaraan rasa di seluruh Indonesia, hanya di Makan Terooos, di mana setiap hidangan memiliki kisahnya sendiri.(n)

programme.title: Konser Luar Biasa Metamorfosis Lesti
programme.desc: Konsert Luar Biasa: Metamorfosis Lesti ialah konsert istimewa yang meraikan perjalanan kerjaya penyanyi dangdut muda, Lesti Kejora. Konsert ini menampilkan detik kejayaannya sejak menjuarai musim pertama Dangdut Academy. Persembahan lagu-lagu hits, rekaan pentas yang menarik, tarian bertenaga, serta kolaborasi bersama artis dangdut terkenal turut memeriahkan acara ini.(n)

programme.desc: Sebuah siri separa dokumentari yang menyeronokkan dan dikendalikan oleh sekumpulan hos cilik yang penuh tenaga. Mereka meneroka pelbagai tempat menarik dan aktiviti yang mengujakan, sambil berkongsi pengalaman dengan semangat ingin tahu dan keceriaan. Setiap episod membawa penonton mengikuti perjalanan yang dipenuhi tawa dan penemuan baharu, sambil menggalakkan kanak-kanak untuk belajar serta mengenali dunia di sekeliling mereka dengan cara yang menyeronokkan dan menarik.(n)

programme.desc: Raina (Aline Fauziah) sering dibandingkan dengan kakaknya, Vinka (Hanifa Alhasni). Tekanan untuk sentiasa menjadi sempurna membuatkan muzik menjadi satu-satunya tempat Raina melarikan diri daripada luka dan tekanan hidup. Di sebalik ejekan rakan-rakannya, Abhay (Rassya Hidayah) sentiasa berada di sisinya sebagai pelindung dan sumber semangat.(n)

Nara sangat gembira kerana perkahwinan Resti membawa kehidupan yang lebih baik untuk mereka, tetapi kegembiraan Nara berakhir seketika apabila dia menemui sesuatu yang menggoncangkan dunianya dan mengancam untuk memisahkan keluarganya.(n)

programme.title: Rindu Bukan Rindu
programme.desc: Rindu Bukan Rindu mengisahkan kisah seorang wanita bernama Rindu yang merasa bertuah memiliki seorang lelaki bernama Devan. Kedua-duanya tinggal di Jepun dan menghabiskan masa bersama. Devan sentiasa berada di dekat Rindu, melindungi dan mencintainya. Hubungan di antara mereka terasa sangat rapat dan sempurna. Tetapi suatu hari, Rindu melihat Devan memegang tangan seorang wanita lain. Apakah yang terjadi di antara mereka?(n)

Nara sangat gembira kerana perkahwinan Resti membawa kehidupan yang lebih baik untuk mereka, tetapi kegembiraan Nara berakhir seketika apabila dia menemui sesuatu yang menggoncangkan dunianya dan mengancam untuk memisahkan keluarganya.(n)

programme.title: Cinta Pertama Belum Kelar
programme.desc: Raisa (Baiti Syaghaf) rupanya adalah bekas kekasih kepada bakal suami kakak kandungnya sendiri. Hal ini diketahui Raisa ketika dia pulang ke kampung untuk menghadiri majlis pertunangan kakaknya. Betapa terkejutnya Raisa apabila mendapati bahawa Raffi (Alex Rio) adalah bakal suami kakaknya (Djihan Ranti). Walaupun begitu, Raisa berusaha untuk menyembunyikan hal tersebut.(n)

programme.title: Cinta Sedalam Rindu
programme.desc: Aluna menyangka takdirnya hanyalah sebagai anak kepada seorang pembantu rumah yang terpaksa mengorbankan cintanya demi Felicia, anak majikannya. Namun, apabila rahsia dari masa lalunya terbongkar, seluruh hidup mereka berubah sama sekali.(n)

programme.title: Foodie Buddy
programme.desc: Program masakan dan kulinari yang meneroka keunikan serta kekayaan cita rasa hidangan Indonesia, menampilkan pelbagai sajian tradisional, ramuan tempatan dan pengalaman kulinari dari seluruh negara.(n)

programme.title: Rindu Bukan Rindu
programme.desc: Rindu Bukan Rindu mengisahkan kisah seorang wanita bernama Rindu yang merasa bertuah memiliki seorang lelaki bernama Devan. Kedua-duanya tinggal di Jepun dan menghabiskan masa bersama. Devan sentiasa berada di dekat Rindu, melindungi dan mencintainya. Hubungan di antara mereka terasa sangat rapat dan sempurna. Tetapi suatu hari, Rindu melihat Devan memegang tangan seorang wanita lain. Apakah yang terjadi di antara mereka?(n)

programme.title: Wanita Istimewa
programme.desc: Mirsa (Alisia Rininta) dan Radit (Reuben Elishama) hidup sederhana di Padang sehingga satu kesilapan besar berlaku apabila Radit tanpa sedar membawa beg berisi dadah. Untuk melindungi suaminya, Mirsa menyerah diri dan dipenjara selama tujuh tahun, manakala bayi yang dilahirkannya terpaksa diserahkan kepada ibu mertuanya untuk dijaga. Selepas dibebaskan, Mirsa mencari keluarganya tetapi mendapati Radit sudah berpindah ke Jakarta. Jejak itu membawa Mirsa ke sebuah acara pelancaran perumahan di mana dia bertemu semula dengan Radit yang kini bersama isterinya Karina (Naomi Zaskia) dan berkenalan dengan Reza (Randy Pangalila), sementara tekanan daripada Pramana (Adipura) terhadap perkahwinan mereka mula terbongkar.(n)

programme.desc: Hong Kong life is vibrant and diverse, and "Hong Kong Life, Hong Kong Enjoyment" presents both sophisticated and elegant lifestyles and down-to-earth, high-quality experiences. programme.title: Hands Up 2026
programme.desc: The brand-new children's program “Hands Up” encourages kids to ask questions bravely, express themselves, and pursue their goals! Members of the mascot “Sauce Family” join the hosts in performing short skits, accompanying everyone for joyful moments. The show will also feature a variety of children's songs, allowing kids to sing along while learning practical life knowledge.(n)

programme.title: Forgotten Valley, The
programme.desc: Highly influenced by western culture, couple LUK SHUI-FUNG (Raymond Wong) and LAW KWAI-SZE (Grace Chan) want to reshape their feudal hometown, Ping On Valley, which has fallen so far behind, but nothing comes out as they wish. Not only are they under the tyrannical dictatorship of their father, Village Chief LUK KAM-KUK (Lau Kong), who constantly stands in their way, but they are also involved in the ghost bride murder mystery, kidnapping and homicide respectively. Victims of bullying including KAM-KUK's concubines SUNG MING-FUNG (Louisa So) and KOO MAN-YEE (Rebecca Zhu), and maid TIN CHOR-YAT (Katy Kung) eventually can't take it anymore. Defying the status quo in the fight for gender equality, they secretly form an alliance to protect other girls who fall victim to this. Unexpectedly, a group of wicked guys headed by butler NG SHEUNG-SHUN (Louis Yuen) bring in bandits for their own selfish motives. While blowing the girls' cover, it also puts the relationship of SHUI-FUNG and KWAI-SZE to the test, escalating the feud between men and women…….(n)

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: "Scoop" airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The "Today's Breaking News" segment keeps viewers up to date with the day's hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.(n)

programme.title: News Treasury 2026
programme.desc: As the saying goes, "Today's news is tomorrow's history." With so much news every day, it's hard for everyone to take it all in, let alone look back at history. History is a treasure trove—if we ignore or underestimate it, we might miss out on its riches. The new program "News Treasure Hunt" guides viewers to uncover news gems from this vault. In addition to special features, live broadcasts, and series reports from the past, the show offers never-before-seen precious footage. Audiences will have the chance to revisit events such as Bruce Lee's funeral, the Bank of Po Sang robbery, the Gang of Four trial, the Queen's visit to Hong Kong, taxi strikes, the signing of the Sino-British Joint Declaration, an exclusive interview with Margaret Thatcher, Vietnamese refugees, the death of Governor Youde, Chris Patten's arrival in Hong Kong, the closure of Kai Tak Airport, the passing of Deng Xiaoping, the 1997 Handover Ceremony, the China Airlines Hong Kong crash, and SARS press conferences.(n)

programme.title: Cantopop At 50
programme.desc: Throughout the years, countless hit songs have emerged in both Chinese and international music scenes. Regardless of the era, every work has its own devoted fans. " Cantopop At 50" invites original singers or accomplished vocalists to reinterpret these once-popular classics that transcend generations, delivering high-quality musical enjoyment to music lovers. In addition to featuring influential senior artists in the music industry, the program also welcomes many singers who have not appeared in public for a long time, bringing multiple surprises to the audience.(n)

programme.title: J Music 2026
programme.desc: J Music is dedicated to creating a high-quality music platform, providing singers with opportunities to showcase their musical talents while allowing music fans to gain a deeper understanding of their musical stories. The program invites popular singers as guests, who personally select their favorite new and old works, perform them live, and share their favorite tracks. New faces in the music scene will also appear, showcasing their musical potential through interactive exchanges. Furthermore, each episode closely follows the latest developments on the Jade Solid Gold Chart, featuring music videos and interviews with various singers, songwriters, and producers, who discuss their work and the people and events within the music industry.(n)

programme.title: News Magazine 2026
programme.desc: "News Perspective" is a weekly program featuring in-depth coverage of notable news stories from Hong Kong and around the world. It focuses on social issues that matter most to Hong Kong residents and invites people from various sectors, scholars, and experts to discuss and analyze the underlying causes and developments.(n)

programme.title: My Family Legacy II
programme.desc: Children take different paths at each stage of life, and parents want to be their strongest support. Is "The Family Tradition of 'Protection'" an important part of this? "Big Brother" Sammo Hung founded the "Hung Clan," and his son, Timmy Hung, continues his father's legacy, contributing to the promotion of martial arts films and hoping to pass it on to his son, Hung Tai-yan. Alex Fong inherited his father's swimming talent, becoming an Olympic swimmer before transitioning to acting and opening a swimming school; though the stage may change, the Fong family's beliefs remain unchanged! Liu Yingxuan, raised abroad, has achieved a confident and beautiful life thanks to her parents' dedicated nurturing. In this video, she washes and dyes her father's hair, a former hairstylist, sharing a heartwarming story of father-daughter affection.(n)

programme.title: Music Money Monster
programme.desc: Pushing the limits of vocal range and precise timing, the brand-new interactive music game show Music Money Monster" is hosted by Sammy, Eric Kwok, and Lee Yin-tung. A professional pitch analysis system tests the contestants. A nine-square grid represents nine difficulty levels. Contestants who connect three lines to "pass the level" can choose to withdraw their winnings, continue the challenge, or even attempt the most difficult Monster level. Failure results in zero prize money! The amateur version allows solo participants to compete for a top prize of NT$100,000. The celebrity version offers viewers a chance to win prizes and gifts by interacting with the contestants in the live stream and sending emojis to cheer them on.(n)

programme.title: Vital Lifeline
programme.desc: Urban dwellers often experience a hectic pace of life and high levels of stress, making them more susceptible to health problems. "The Strongest Lifeline" helps you unravel the secrets to good health. To start, the program features a four-episode series on common urban pain issues, covering headaches, shoulder and neck pain, back pain, and joint pain. Each episode invites medical experts to explain the causes of these conditions, as well as physical therapists and exercise specialists to teach appropriate exercises. With the growing trend of integrating Eastern and Western medicine, even American swimming champion Michael Phelps uses cupping therapy to relieve pain. Therefore, each episode also includes traditional Chinese medical diagnosis, complemented by treatments such as acupuncture, cupping, and the “Sanfu” herbal patch therapy, which is especially suitable during the hottest days of summer. In addition, Chinese medicine practitioners share recipes for nourishing soups, all of which can help regulate and improve your health.(n)

programme.title: Severe Case Decoded
programme.desc: As the saying goes, "Reading ten thousand books is not as good as traveling ten thousand miles." Wayne Lai and Mak Cheung-ching embark on another journey, continuing their exploration of the magnificent landscapes depicted in Jin Yong's novels and delving into the martial arts world of Chinese history. They travel along the Yangtze and Yellow River basins, traversing Sichuan, Zhejiang, Henan, and Shanxi provinces, climbing Mount Emei's Golden Summit, visiting Baidi City, the Yue Fei Temple in Zhuxian Town, and exploring the Shaolin Temple on Mount Song. They experienced the weight of historical sites and savored local delicacies. The martial arts world is not only a stage for swords and shadows, but also a realm of intertwined human relationships. During their journey, they also reunited with Michelle Yim, Benny Chan, Louis Fan, and Jackie Lui, reminiscing about their past collaborations and laughing about bygone days.(n)

programme.title: The Inner Eye & What's On Today
programme.desc: When “The Inner Eye “follows Shenzhen lawyer Tang Yingying as she handles a series of controversial cases and gradually transforms from someone driven by victory and profit into a lawyer who rediscovers her professional conscience. Through cases involving sexual assault allegations, inheritance disputes, emotional and medical conflicts, domestic violence, and public opinion against lawyers, she witnesses the darkness and vulnerability of human nature. As the lives of Dai Peilin, Lin Xiaoyun, Kang Jun, Fang Weian and others intertwine with hers, Tang learns to “cover her eyes” and listen to her inner sense of justice and integrity, ultimately finding her own rebirth in law, love and life.(n)

This trip to Malaysia was a rare "girls' getaway," filled with delicious food, fun activities, and experiencing the local culture. During the trip, the four beautiful hosts each invited their friends Lai Lok-yi, Mat Yeung, and Ma Kwun-tung to join them, traveling to Selangor, Pahang, Terengganu, Kelantan, and Sabah. programme.title: Winter Night
programme.desc: Zheng Daqian (Qiao Xin), a struggling office worker suffering setbacks in both love and career due to urban life's hardships, receives compensation for the demolition of her hometown in Northeast China and embarks on a journey back. A geomagnetic storm caused by a fireball leaves her train stranded in the wilderness. Witnessing the fireball, Zheng Daqian is shocked to find herself transported to a parallel universe! There, she encounters her deceased father, her mother who left despite never divorcing her, and her childhood friend and lost first love, Mu Zili (Ma Sichao)! Unable to return to her original world, Zheng Daqian seizes this opportunity to make amends for her past regrets, and the seeds of a budding romance with Mu Zili begin to sprout with the arrival of spring. Unfortunately, the fireball reappears, and Zheng Daqian and Mu Zili are destined to become lovers separated by two worlds, unable to touch each other…!(n)

programme.title: Walking With You

This trip to Malaysia was a rare "girls' getaway," filled with delicious food, fun activities, and experiencing the local culture. During the trip, the four beautiful hosts each invited their friends Lai Lok-yi, Mat Yeung, and Ma Kwun-tung to join them, traveling to Selangor, Pahang, Terengganu, Kelantan, and Sabah. programme.title: The Inner Eye & What's On Today
programme.desc: When “The Inner Eye “follows Shenzhen lawyer Tang Yingying as she handles a series of controversial cases and gradually transforms from someone driven by victory and profit into a lawyer who rediscovers her professional conscience. Through cases involving sexual assault allegations, inheritance disputes, emotional and medical conflicts, domestic violence, and public opinion against lawyers, she witnesses the darkness and vulnerability of human nature. As the lives of Dai Peilin, Lin Xiaoyun, Kang Jun, Fang Weian and others intertwine with hers, Tang learns to “cover her eyes” and listen to her inner sense of justice and integrity, ultimately finding her own rebirth in law, love and life.(n)

programme.title: Scam Alert!
programme.desc: The number of various scams continues to rise, with the amounts involved becoming increasingly staggering. It is reported that Hong Kong suffers an average daily loss of HK$25 million, with a scam occurring every 13 minutes… Scams targeting online shopping, job seeking, investment, dating apps, and telephone scams are becoming increasingly sophisticated. Citizens must raise their awareness of scams and be vigilant to avoid falling victim! Hosts Au Wing-Kuen, Edwin Siu, Lee Man-Fong, and Leung Man-Hau gather various real-life cases to gain a deeper understanding of how victims were scammed. The program will also recreate these scenarios in story form. Experts will appear to dissect different methods of committing these crimes, helping viewers identify money-grabbing traps and avoid becoming targets of scammers!(n)

programme.title: The Ahistoric Grandpa Cooking Show (Sr.5)
programme.desc: Li Jiading (Master Ding), the tough guy, is undoubtedly a master of martial arts, but it turns out his culinary skills are equally impressive! Master Ding has set up "Master Ding's Kitchen," partnering with the discerning food connoisseur Tan Yuying. Each episode takes viewers on a sourcing trip for their favorite ingredients, and Master Ding personally cooks a variety of his signature dishes, soups, and desserts, offering a taste of nostalgic Cantonese cuisine! How to cook authentic traditional salt-baked chicken at an affordable price? How to control the heat and time when steaming fish? In autumn and winter, many people love fragrant claypot rice, especially the crispy rice crust. But have you ever seen claypot rice with crispy rice on both sides? Watch Master Ding show off his skills and teach you how!(n)

programme.title: Winter Night
programme.desc: Zheng Daqian (Qiao Xin), a struggling office worker suffering setbacks in both love and career due to urban life's hardships, receives compensation for the demolition of her hometown in Northeast China and embarks on a journey back. A geomagnetic storm caused by a fireball leaves her train stranded in the wilderness. Witnessing the fireball, Zheng Daqian is shocked to find herself transported to a parallel universe! There, she encounters her deceased father, her mother who left despite never divorcing her, and her childhood friend and lost first love, Mu Zili (Ma Sichao)! Unable to return to her original world, Zheng Daqian seizes this opportunity to make amends for her past regrets, and the seeds of a budding romance with Mu Zili begin to sprout with the arrival of spring. Unfortunately, the fireball reappears, and Zheng Daqian and Mu Zili are destined to become lovers separated by two worlds, unable to touch each other…!(n)

programme.title: Gourmet Express
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demand—what are the must-try picks? The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the "stories behind the flavors.".(n)

programme.title: The Joy Of Nature
programme.desc: Taiwan's camping destinations are breathtaking! Hong Kong host Lin Yinghui, along with three of Taiwan's goddesses Lin Xiang, Zhang Yahan, and Huang Shangyan, embarked on a nature-themed healing trip. They traversed Nantou, Kaohsiung, Taoyuan, and other locations, delving into the Miaoli mountains, trying out forest cabins, luxury campervans, deluxe tents, and even camping at a baseball stadium… Surrounded by mountains, they enjoyed open-air hot springs, watched the sunset at the beach, explored historical sites near the campsites, and immersed themselves in nature. Finally, they returned to Yangmingshan in Taipei for camping, soaking in hot springs, and overlooking the unparalleled night view of Taipei! Besides experiencing the unique atmosphere of camping, what sparks will fly between the Taiwanese and Hong Kong women as they interact and bond?(n)

Stay updated every night with the latest news from Hong Kong's entertainment industry, as well as film and entertainment news from around the world. We report on the newest developments of artists, promotions for TV series and movies, highlights from concerts, and coverage of grand award ceremonies. We even travel abroad to cover major entertainment events, track international movie stars, and conduct exclusive interviews with well-known singers, actors, and television personalities familiar to our audience—ensuring you can instantly grasp the latest happenings and news in the world of film and entertainment.(n)

programme.title: News Roundup
programme.desc: Reporting major news from Hong Kong, across the Taiwan Strait, and around the world, as well as sports updates, keeping you informed about important events and trends in the world of sports.(n)

programme.title: Global View
programme.desc: " Global View," curated by seasoned journalists, guides you to view the world with a global perspective—broadening your horizons, expanding your understanding of the news, and enriching your knowledge.(n)

programme.title: Big Boys Club
programme.desc: " Big Boys Club" is a youth talk show hosted by a group of close friends—Bob Lam, Oscar Leung, Derek Wong, Philip Fan, and Alan Chan. In each episode, singers, entertainers, or guests from various fields are invited for relaxed interviews, presenting a wide range of topics including current social issues, pop culture, and trending interests. Matters of love, relationships, and even same-sex relationships are endlessly discussed topics for men and women alike. The show invites guests from diverse backgrounds to explore love and relationships, delving into the dynamics between the sexes. The "Other Dimension" segment features guests sharing extraordinary experiences, such as encounters with ghosts, UFOs, and bizarre happenings, bringing thrilling topics to the audience.(n)

programme.title: Another Era
programme.desc: In 2008, as the tsunami of financial chaos engulfed the world, ambitious entrepreneur HO TIN-SANG (Kwok Chun On) saw the opportunity seeking to take over the richest man in Hong Kong, FONG CHUNG-YAM's (Wu Fung) business empire, but was interfered by another business magnate CHEUK KAI-TONG (Pat Poon). Bearing animosity towards him, TIN-SANG has been seeking revenge since then. Ten years later, the now wealthiest Cheuk family is overshadowed by misfortune. The sudden death of KAI-TONG's son comes as a crushing blow to KAI-TONG, who lapses into a coma after a heart attack. To keep their business going, his inexperienced younger daughter CHEUK DING-YIU (Chow Lai Ki, Niki), with the help of a private equity placement agent, KO CHIT (Frankie Lam), faces off with TIN-SANG. With KAI-TONG regaining consciousness, TIN-SANG's wife CHEUNG MING-HEI (Tavia Yeung), CHUNG-YAM's grandson FONG CHAK-YU (Benjamin Yuen) and aspiring young entrepreneur CHING HOI (Chau Pak Ho) also get involved in the ever-escalating power struggle. The enmity among them will soon intensify towards a full-blown rivalry…….(n)

programme.title: Mrs. RevengeWhat's On Today
programme.desc: Human desires can drive us to transform ourselves. However, when desires get out of line due to pure greed for money and power, or even fanciful lust, so much so that whimsical imaginings are infinitely exaggerated. And unintentionally, you just fall into the abyss of moral dilemma and commit all kinds of Deadly Sins. Crime Unit, New Territories East investigates successive cases, including Faceless Corpse, Stone Coffin, $100 Million Motive for Murder, Dangerous Game, Dirty Bullet and Terrifying Lover. Perplexing clues and tangled relationships become the foundation of a series of unbelievable mysteries, revealing the baffling dark side of human nature.(n)

programme.title: Lo And Behold
programme.desc: HUNG SHU-KAN (Lau Dan) built his own logistics business from scratch and now everything is in order. The only thing on his mind is the well-being of his three daughters. His eldest daughter has moved abroad, but his second youngest daughter, HUNG YUEK-SHUI (Koni Lui), is still single. She and her little prodigy sister, HUNG SUM-YUE (Andrea So), often fight over small things, putting their father in dilemmas.(n)

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: "Scoop" airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The "Today's Breaking News" segment keeps viewers up to date with the day's hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.(n)

programme.title: Severe Case Decoded
programme.desc: Severe Case Decoded follows a specialized police unit that tackles bizarre cold cases inspired by real-life Hong Kong crimes.(n)

programme.title: Winter Night
programme.desc: Zheng Daqian (Qiao Xin), a struggling office worker suffering setbacks in both love and career due to urban life's hardships, receives compensation for the demolition of her hometown in Northeast China and embarks on a journey back. A geomagnetic storm caused by a fireball leaves her train stranded in the wilderness. Witnessing the fireball, Zheng Daqian is shocked to find herself transported to a parallel universe! There, she encounters her deceased father, her mother who left despite never divorcing her, and her childhood friend and lost first love, Mu Zili (Ma Sichao)! Unable to return to her original world, Zheng Daqian seizes this opportunity to make amends for her past regrets, and the seeds of a budding romance with Mu Zili begin to sprout with the arrival of spring. Unfortunately, the fireball reappears, and Zheng Daqian and Mu Zili are destined to become lovers separated by two worlds, unable to touch each other…!(n)

programme.title: Big City Shop 2026
programme.desc: “Big City Shop” introduces viewers to a wide range of timely topics, including seasonal products, health and wellness, fitness activities, skincare and makeup, fashion apparel, infant care, parenting knowledge, local delicacies, and pet care trends. The content is all-encompassing! In addition to hands-on demonstrations, experiences, or tests by the hosts, experts are invited to share their professional insights. In the cooking segment, several skilled culinary experts take turns showcasing simple and delicious healthy dishes and home-style recipes, helping everyone solve their cooking challenges.(n)

programme.title: Happy Old Buddies
programme.desc: Many people may think that older adults do not have sexual needs, but surveys have shown that this is not the case—older adults often experience less sexual activity due to various reasons. Clinical psychologist Lin Haoming from the Social Welfare Department explains the World Health Organization's definition of sexuality and offers advice for those hoping to rekindle their sex life with their partner. However, if one partner does not wish to resume sexual activity, how should both sides communicate?(n)

programme.title: Dolce Vita 2022
programme.desc: Hong Kong life is vibrant and diverse, and "Hong Kong Life, Hong Kong Enjoyment" presents both sophisticated and elegant lifestyles and down-to-earth, high-quality experiences. The program combines diverse themes, exploring different areas in each episode and inviting elites from various industries to share their secrets to success.(n)

When drought destroys their harvest and debts pile up, he is forced to take on extra fishing and even sell his own blood just to keep the family afloat. Despite hardship, he continues to face life with optimism, teaching his children resilience and hope as each of them grows toward their own future.(n)

programme.title: Blessing of Formosa
programme.desc: The beauty of folklore is all around us in Taiwan, but we often overlook it and fail to appreciate and feel it. The aim of this program is to promote the beauty of Taiwanese folklore and bring folklore to life. This program showcases folk culture regardless of race or religion, and presents travel information in a fun way, combining easy-to-understand folk culture knowledge with the mission of passing on folk culture. The audience can learn more about folk cultural products such as handicrafts, antiques, temple folklore, as well as short stories about the gods, and information about local tourism. It is an educational and entertaining way to travel and learn about folklore.(n)
